definitions.explanation: A country other than one's own. Often used in writing, news, and formal speech as a slightly more abstract alternative to {外国|がいこく}.

examples.japanese: {他国|たこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{他国|たこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Comparison with other countries is necessary.

examples.japanese: {他国|たこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧にして、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Using other countries' systems as a reference, they created a new law.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧ (other) + {国|こく} (country). More common in written and analytical contexts than in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {他国|たこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: other countries' cultures
- {他国|たこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べる→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧: to compare with other countries
- {他国|たこく}{民|みん}: foreign nationals (literary)
- {他国|たこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use other countries' examples as reference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧: foreign country — the everyday word, neutral and common
- ⟦{異国|いこく}→異国：13721_ikoku⟧: foreign land — literary, suggests exoticism
- ⟦{自国|じこく}→自国：14013_jikoku⟧: one's own country — direct antonym
